⚠️ (B) definition mismatch

SPEC:
- Select muons with pT > 25 GeV and |eta| < 2.4

CODE:
- [l for l in leptons if l['pt'] > 25 and abs(l['eta']) < 2.5]

Reason:
The code selects muons with |eta| < 2.5 instead of the required |eta| < 2.4.

Evidence priority:
- The code uses abs(l['eta']) < 2.5 for muon selection. 〔L279-L281〕

❓ (D) specification ambiguity

SPEC:
- Plot the pT of the subleading b-jet

CODE:
- subleading_bjet_pt_list.append(subleading_bjet['pt'])

Reason:
The code uses the subleading b-jet from the sorted list of selected_bjets, which may not be the same as the subleading b-jet in the event.

Evidence priority:
- The code appends subleading_bjet['pt'] to the list. 〔L357〕

❓ (D) specification ambiguity

SPEC:
- Plot the number of jets per event

CODE:
- njet_list.append(len(selected_jets))

Reason:
The code uses the number of selected jets (with pT > 30 GeV and |eta| < 2.5) instead of the total number of jets in the event.

Evidence priority:
- The code appends len(selected_jets) to the list. 〔L362〕

❓ (D) specification ambiguity

SPEC:
- Plot the HT distribution (scalar sum of all jet pT)

CODE:
- ht_list.append(scalar_pt_sum(selected_jets))

Reason:
The code uses the scalar sum of selected jets (with pT > 30 GeV and |eta| < 2.5) instead of the scalar sum of all jets in the event.

Evidence priority:
- The code appends scalar_pt_sum(selected_jets) to the list. 〔L361〕

⚠️ (B) definition mismatch

SPEC:
- Plot the eta of the leading b-jet

CODE:
- leading_bjet_eta_list.append(leading_bjet['eta'])

Reason:
The code uses the leading b-jet from the sorted list of selected_bjets, which may not be the same as the leading b-jet in the event.

Evidence priority:
- The code appends leading_bjet['eta'] to the list. 〔L363〕
